propositions: Frontier exclusion-list inserted as data-shaped evidence block in untrusted fence does not suppress re-search of listed paths; model re-reads them as re-grounding step for unproven criteria.

Treatment arm (frontier-augmented resumption) shows higher re-search overlap rate (44.4% and 80.0%) than control arm (25.0% and 50.0%) on both test tickets, failing the predeclared >=30% relative reduction threshold.

Cache-seeded resume (locust behavior) already removes dominant redundancy by skipping re-verification of credited criteria; residual re-search of unproven criteria cannot be suppressed by untrusted fence evidence blocks.
Frontier block acts as signpost naming files with evidence, causing model to immediately re-read those files in resumption, increasing measured overlap rather than reducing it.

No production code changes required; PoC harness used monkeypatching of cache_dir, verify_step_floor, and completion_precheck; experiment showed mechanism does not reduce overlap measurably (frontier block rendered inert by fence design).
Token cost of treatment arm increased without benefit (3.1-21.9% input, 0.3-34% output per attempt) on both tickets; real investment in production telemetry not warranted based on PoC result.
